translations.web: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
translations.bsb: For you say, ‘Where now is the nobleman’s house, and where are the tents in which the wicked dwell?’
translations.kjv: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?
translations.asv: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? And where is the tent wherein the wicked dwelt?
